rules.description: Global machine-state singleton updated continuously by Falcon.Net on every program/state transition; records the active job, product, and recipe.
Setup-level identity file recording the setup name, GUID, version, and last active recipe. Written by RMS at setup creation.
Top-level job identity file storing the human-readable job name, unique GUID, version counter, and optional free-text tag. Written by RMS at job creation.
Accumulates per-wafer production statistics (defect counts, die yield ratios, class hit counts, batch pass count) updated by RMS after each wafer scan.
Defines multi-recipe scan orchestration — which recipes are active, their execution order, merge strategy, per-recipe alignment and sampling flags, and AQL criteria per scan.
Controls whether defects are grouped into clusters after scanning, and specifies the clustering algorithm, proximity threshold, and defect sort order for display and reporting.
Optional gate that can block scanning based on an external or internal condition; contains a single active/inactive flag.
Stores the 2×3 affine transformation matrix mapping wafer coordinates to chuck/stage coordinates, computed after wafer alignment, along with per-anchor residuals.
Top-level recipe control file governing auto-cycle behavior — autofocus and clean-reference frequencies, post-processing flags, and recipe identity.
Stores all product-level wafer parameters: die geometry, pitch, wafer diameter, scan flags, robot configuration, reference die coordinates, and surface mapping mode.
Configures wafer handling and scan automation settings — robot pre-aligner rotation, hardware dependency flags, auto-cycle mode, and OCR/ink-dot options.
Global real-time parameter set controlling scan-time thresholds and algorithm settings across all zones in this recipe.
Recipe real-time parameter file containing per-recipe thresholds and algorithm controls, updated during scan setup.
Defines optical zoom level settings and magnification parameters for recipe image capture and review.
Defines the scan zone layout — zone names, boundaries, and inclusion flags — for this recipe.
Wafer geometry parameters derived from the product definition and applied during scanning — diameter, notch position, and edge exclusion.
Per-zone detection thresholds, algorithm selection, and sensitivity settings applied during scanning of this zone.
Records the coarse alignment completion status and the resulting rotation residual for the current recipe load.
Real-time parameters controlling alignment algorithm thresholds, search window sizes, and scoring criteria.
Parameterised alignment settings derived from the recipe definition and applied during the alignment step.
Stores the alignment results for the current recipe run — rotation, offset, and residual error data.
Machine system parameters applied to this recipe — hardware settings, scan configuration, and calibration references.
Optical channel preset configuration — illumination levels, exposure settings, and camera parameters for this recipe.
Per-job illumination boundary constraints that bound the allowable range of optical settings for this recipe.
Maps physical optical channels to virtual camera indices used in image acquisition and processing for this recipe.
Baseline wafer-to-table affine transform stored at setup creation; used as the initial transform before any live alignment run has been performed.
Recipe-level baseline wafer-to-table affine transform; used as the initial transform before any live alignment run for this recipe.
Stored alignment data for the recipe — position corrections and transformation parameters from previous alignment runs.
Records timing measurements from the alignment procedure for performance monitoring and diagnostics.
Per-run alignment measurements and anchor point data from the most recent alignment procedure.
Stores the reference die position used for focus mapping, expressed in chuck coordinates.
Transform mapping camera frame coordinates to chuck coordinates, used in training and reference image acquisition.
Metadata describing the reference images available for this recipe — creation timestamps, version, and validity flags.
Human-readable zone description file listing zone names and properties for display and reporting.
Metadata for defined inspection scenarios — which algorithm configurations and parameter sets are active.
Local colorimetric calibration measurements for this recipe, used by the color correction system.
Configuration governing how clean reference images are captured and managed for this recipe.
Final parameter set applied when generating a clean reference — averaging options, outlier rejection, and acceptance criteria.
Options controlling 3D reference image creation — height map settings, capture parameters, and stitching options.
Settings for overlay scanning mode — scan coverage, reference comparison method, and overlay tolerance.
Configuration for the sampling metrology scan — measurement sites, frequency, and data capture options.
Defines die areas that receive special inspection treatment — different thresholds, algorithms, or exclusion rules.
Controls wafer map import and update settings at recipe scope — external map ingestion, fiducial matching, and map update policy.
Stores the transformation parameters aligning the current wafer to the reference wafer used for defect comparison.
Die grid block layout at recipe scope — die count, row/column indices, physical positions, and die dimensions in µm.
Alignment residuals and correction data from the die map alignment procedure.
XML configuration for the colorimetric calibration system setup — sensor parameters, correction profiles, and calibration targets.
Focus height map data for the recipe — height samples across the wafer surface used to maintain focus during scanning.
Configuration for the training die used in reference image acquisition — die position and image capture settings.
Reference position data used during training image acquisition for this recipe.
Wafer information data file containing geometric and process parameters for the current wafer.
Registration position data for the die map — anchor coordinates used to align the die map to the wafer.
Die registration position data — coordinates used to locate individual dice on the wafer for inspection.
Binary die mapping data defining the wafer die grid — which dice are included or excluded from inspection.
Binary die registration position data used to locate dice on the wafer during scanning.
Binary die map registration data — anchor and alignment positions for the die grid.
Binary zone data file containing the compiled zone geometry and inclusion masks for this recipe.
Defines external coordinate system transformations applied during result export and KLARF generation.
XML configuration controlling how external wafer data (KLARF, maps) is ingested and parsed for this recipe.
Calibration metadata for optical light channels — reference intensity values and normalization parameters.
Internal log of recipe parameter transactions — records which parameters were changed and when during recipe editing.
Transform mapping die image coordinates to chuck table coordinates, used in training image acquisition.
Zoom level settings for training die image capture — magnification and resolution parameters.
Zoom level configuration for the reference image backup set.
Optical preset snapshot stored during QA verification runs — used for audit and comparison.
Log of scan strip overlap measurements recorded during the scan — used to verify scan coverage and stitch quality.
Metadata for the scan overview image — capture parameters, dimensions, and file references.
Manifest describing the frame data binary — frame count, dimensions, and scan parameters.
Verbose log of image processing operations — algorithm steps, timing, and diagnostic output for each scanned frame.
Per-die copy of the recipe-level zone definition (MPW_From_cad jobs) — same schema as Recipes\*\zones.ini, scoped to a single die variant.
Acceptance Quality Limit thresholds applied at scan completion — defines defect-count limits per wafer/zone that determine pass/fail at recipe scope.
Edge Bead Removal inspection parameters — wafer edge exclusion zone and EBR detection thresholds.
Top-level zone layout file (variant naming, outside the Recipes folder) — equivalent semantics to Recipes\*\zones.ini but at job or setup scope.
Current wafer surface height interpolation data captured during the active scan; updated per wafer alignment run.
Manual wafer alignment data captured when the operator performs a manual align — point coordinates and adjustments recorded for the run.
Snapshot of the most recent successful wafer-to-table transform — preserved across runs as a fallback if the next alignment fails.
Real-time parameter dump written when alignment fails — used for diagnostics of failed alignment cycles.
Set of focus mapping anchor points selected for the current scan — feeds height adjustments during scanning.
Wafer level-up (WLUP) alignment data captured during alignment — per-run height correction reference points.
Recipe-level wafer level-up (WLUP) reference data used for height alignment at scan start.
Snapshot of scenario metadata at recipe scope — recorded for traceability of the inspection scenario in use.
Binary recipe blob containing serialized recipe state at recipe scope.
Focus model parameters for a specific model variant under the recipe focus map — captured during focus model training.
Zoom-level configuration at setup scope (outside Recipes) — supersedes recipe defaults when present at the higher level.
CAD-to-job recipe mapping captured during training — describes how the CAD layout was transferred into the recipe.
Recipes index file listing the recipes present under this job/setup — used by RMS to enumerate recipes for the job.
CTS scan configuration (Compound Tolerance Scan) — per-site scan definition under the ScanCTS_* subfolder.
Manual CTS optic-setup sites list — operator-selected sites for compound-tolerance optic setup.
Binary bumps data file for the recipe — bump locations and dimensions used in bumping-process inspection.
Per-site manual scanned site XML under CTS optic setup — records the manually-acquired image and its parameters.
CAD reference metadata at training scope — describes the CAD reference used during recipe creation.
Manual masking definition at recipe scope — operator-drawn masking regions excluded from inspection.
CAD-derived clean-reference segments — per-segment reference image metadata for clean reference generation.
Scan restriction settings at recipe scope — operator-imposed limits on which die or zones are scanned.
FalconAuditService per-job audit manifest — records jobName, auditDbVersion, created/lastSeen machine and timestamps, and sealed flag. Single file under c:\\job\\ written by the audit service itself.
Custom scripts hook configuration — paths to operator scripts invoked at scan lifecycle events.
Multi-light-channel illumination definition — enabled channels and per-channel parameters at job scope.
TNE setup configuration at recipe scope — TNE (Three-axis Non-orthogonality) calibration parameters.
Zones vector information at training scope — vector representations of zone polygons used by the die map.
Dice instances list at recipe scope — block-level enumeration of die instances and their attributes.
Dice locations as read from CAD at training scope — pre-deformation die positions.
Scan-area polygon vector data at training scope — defines the wafer area inspected.
Die mapping text export at recipe scope — human-readable die index list.
Die offset table at recipe scope — per-die position corrections applied during scanning.
Critical Tolerance Window repeatability report at job/setup scope — multi-run repeatability statistics for QA verification.
Per-die text artifacts under MPW_From_cad jobs — per-die copies of recipe-level text files (DieMapRegPos, DieRegPos, etc.) scoped to a single die variant.
Per-die zoom-level configuration under MPW_From_cad jobs — copy of recipe-level ZoomLevels.ini scoped to a die variant.
Per-die backup of zoom levels under the die-variant reference-backup folder.
Zone-level optics verification flags at recipe scope — per-zone enable/disable of optics verification.
Sidecar manifest for binary s_*.dat files (e.g. s_FrameData.dat.md) — describes the binary content layout.
CTS optic-setup summary at recipe scope — final summary written when CTS optic setup completes.
Generic Sites*.xml at recipe scope — site definition variants beyond the canonical Sites.xml.
Transitions XML at job/setup scope — state-transition definitions for the inspection workflow.
OpticsPreset variant under a per-machine or QA subfolder of the recipe — case-and-machine-specific optical preset.
Stamped by VCamInstaller during deploy — one per VCAM-prefixed job. Records the installer GUID applied to the job folder.
Default wafer surface interpolation file at job scope — baseline used when no fresh interpolation is available.
Per-machine default alignment file under a sub-subfolder of the recipe — initial alignment used when the live alignment is not yet available for this machine.
Scan overview image metadata — capture parameters and dimensions of the overview image written per scan.
Processing reference data under the ProcessingRef folder — reference artifacts used by post-processing.
Unique result-type identifiers at recipe scope — enumeration of result-type IDs surfaced in this recipe.
Scan-strip overlap log for 3D mode — per-scan overlap measurements specific to 3D acquisition.
Per-AF-site focus-curve diagnostic dump under DebugAFMapping — high-volume, one file per AF site.
Focus-mapping debug tables under DebugAFMapping — per-pass diagnostic output of the focus mapping algorithm.
